title: Pure Drytron
summary: Drytron cards only, with generic staples; the page's Herald of Ultimateness and Cyber Angel partners are left out, and so is Ursarctic Drytron, which needs the Ursarctic cards. The Drytron monsters are 2000 ATK Level 1s that tribute each other to summon themselves and search, and Meteonis Drytron Ritual Summons by tributing ATK instead of Levels, so two of them make a 4000 ATK Ritual Monster. The 2024 cards lead. Drytron Nu II summons itself from the hand or GY while a Drytron card is on the field and searches a Drytron monster. Drytron Meteonis DA Draconids negates monster effects twice per turn by banishing Drytrons from the GY. Meteoroa Drytron recovers banished Drytrons and Ritual Summons from the hand or GY.
